_note: Gallery and demo-deck captures (PRD H4, §8): real screenshots of the deployed site, made by scripts/capture_media.py. Eight PNG + two GIF, each at most max_bytes (Space Apps project page limit 10 MB).
_viewports_note: Per-shot viewport (CSS px) for full-page shots that also go into the demo deck: close to the deck image slot (544 × 608 px, about 0.9 wide per tall), so the slide shows the whole shot without cropping.
_example_gif_note: Landscape GIF of the one-kilometre example (P4p): the first screen, then the page after 'Show me the one-kilometre example', then the Earth view at each point button in turn. Viewport screenshots (CSS px x scale); hold_ms per frame, first/after = the first two frames.

deck_png._note: Demo-deck crops (readable at slide size): each shot = the union of its selectors on the live Compare page, default scenarios. 'open' = a card block opened first. Optional per-shot 'viewport' (CSS px) overrides the deck viewport. 'click' = an element clicked first, then 'ready' awaited (shots after it see the clicked state, so such shots go last). 'year' is also a gallery image (item d). Optional per-shot 'pad' overrides pad. A shot with its own viewport goes last (resizing re-lays out the page). A shot with 'query' opens the Compare page with those scenarios (a shareable link) on its own page, after the others.
